title: OfficeKit Presentation Program JSON v1
description: The strict, bounded, public source language for OfficeKit presentations. Coordinates and sizes are expressed in points.

style.description: Optional direct text-style fallback used by the bounded authored style-precedence profile. It is not a source-bound native style owner.
Optional direct text-style fallback used by the bounded authored style-precedence profile. It is not a source-bound native style owner.

fontScheme.description: Bounded authored major/minor theme font families lowered to the native a:fontScheme. It does not model imported theme XML or host font fallback.

accentColors.description: Bounded authored accent1 through accent6 theme colors lowered to the native a:clrScheme. It does not model the remaining theme color roles or imported theme XML.

accentTransforms.description: Bounded authored a:tint/a:shade/a:lumMod/a:lumOff/a:alphaMod/a:alphaOff/a:satMod/a:satOff/a:redMod/a:redOff/a:greenMod/a:greenOff/a:blueMod/a:blueOff/a:hueMod/a:hueOff/a:gray/a:comp/a:inv/a:gamma/a:invGamma transforms for accent1 through accent6. Transforms remain separate from the base accentColors and do not model imported theme XML.

colorRoles.description: Bounded authored dark/light and hyperlink theme color roles lowered to the native a:clrScheme. Values accept RGB or RGBA; only the alpha suffix is lowered, while tint/shade, effect schemes, and imported theme XML remain outside the profile.

textStyle.description: Optional direct text-style fallback used by the bounded authored style-precedence profile. It is not a source-bound native theme style owner.

majorEastAsia.description: Optional East Asian typeface for the major theme role; omitted values fall back to major.

majorComplexScript.description: Optional complex-script typeface for the major theme role; omitted values fall back to major.

minorEastAsia.description: Optional East Asian typeface for the minor theme role; omitted values fall back to minor.

minorComplexScript.description: Optional complex-script typeface for the minor theme role; omitted values fall back to minor.

themeFontScheme.description: The bounded OOXML theme font roles. OfficeKit writes major/minor into the Latin slots; majorEastAsia and minorEastAsia may override the corresponding East Asian slots, majorComplexScript and minorComplexScript may override the corresponding complex-script slots, and omitted values retain each role's fallback.

themeAccentColors.description: The six bounded OOXML accent color roles. Values are six- or eight-digit RGB/RGBA colors; only the alpha suffix is lowered, while hyperlink, followed-hyperlink, dark/light, tint/shade, and effect schemes remain outside this profile.

themeAccentTransforms.description: Optional direct DrawingML color transforms for the six authored accent roles.

tint.description: Mix the accent toward white by this fraction.

shade.description: Mix the accent toward black by this fraction after tint.

lumMod.description: Multiply the accent luminance by this fraction.

lumOff.description: Add this signed fraction to the accent luminance.

alphaMod.description: Multiply the accent alpha by this fraction.

alphaOff.description: Add this signed fraction to the accent alpha.

satMod.description: Multiply the accent saturation by this fraction.

satOff.description: Add this signed fraction to the accent saturation.

redMod.description: Multiply the accent red channel by this fraction.

redOff.description: Add this signed fraction to the accent red channel.

greenMod.description: Multiply the accent green channel by this fraction.

greenOff.description: Add this signed fraction to the accent green channel.

blueMod.description: Multiply the accent blue channel by this fraction.

blueOff.description: Add this signed fraction to the accent blue channel.

hueMod.description: Multiply the accent hue by this fraction.

hueOff.description: Add this signed degree offset to the accent hue.

gray.description: Convert the accent color to grayscale.

comp.description: Apply the accent color complement operation.

gamma.description: Apply gamma correction to the accent color.

invGamma.description: Apply inverse gamma correction to the accent color.

themeColorRoles.description: The six bounded OOXML theme color roles outside accent1 through accent6. Values are six- or eight-digit RGB/RGBA colors; only the alpha suffix is lowered.

tint.description: Mix the resolved color toward white by this fraction. Applied after token lookup.

shade.description: Mix the resolved color toward black by this fraction. Applied after tint.

grammarTokenRef.description: A typed design-grammar token reference. The compiler checks the referenced token kind at the use site.

groupChildFrame.description: The group's local child coordinate rectangle, mapped by DrawingML chOff/chExt. It has no independent rotation or flip; those belong to the outer frame.

opacity.description: Element-level normal opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.

fit.description: Image paint fit may be a literal or a design grammar token of kind string; the resolved value must be cover, contain, stretch, or tile.

opacity.description: Image paint opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.

x.description: Normalized horizontal focal point in the source image.

y.description: Normalized vertical focal point in the source image.

width.description: Stroke width in points; a token reference must declare kind size.

opacity.description: Stroke opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.
Shadow opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.
Glow opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.
Inner-shadow opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.

startOpacity.description: Reflection start opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.

endOpacity.description: Reflection end opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.

fit.description: Reusable image paint fit. A grammar token must declare kind string and resolve to a supported fit.

opacity.description: Reusable image opacity; a grammar token must declare kind opacity.

fontFamilyComplexScript.description: Direct DrawingML a:cs typeface for complex-script text; no host font fallback is inferred.

style.description: Optional text-body layout for structured rich text. It is kept separate from per-paragraph style and applies only to the text container.

break.description: A native DrawingML line break. It is an ordered inline and does not create a new paragraph.

source.description: Bounded LaTeX source without \( and \) delimiters. Unsupported commands fail closed; OfficeKit never renders the backslashes as literal fallback text.

automatic.description: Whether this is a bounded automatic field. The current profile supports type slidenum, which refreshes from the owning slide number, and types author, datetime, datetimeFigureOut, datetime1, datetime2, datetime3, datetime4, datetime5, datetime6, datetime7, datetime8, datetime9, datetime10, datetime11, datetime12, datetime13, uaqdatetime1, uaqdatetime2, uaqdatetime3, uaqdatetime4, uaqdatetime5, uaqdatetime6, and uaqdatetime7, which preserve their cached display for the host to refresh. datetimeFigureOut is equivalent to datetime1 and requests MM/DD/YYYY; datetime1 requests MM/DD/YYYY, datetime2 requests Day, Month DD, YYYY, datetime3 requests DD Month YYYY, datetime4 requests Month DD, YYYY, datetime5 requests DD-Mon-YY, datetime6 requests Month YY, datetime7 requests Mon-YY, datetime8 requests MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm AM/PM, datetime9 requests MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss AM/PM, datetime10 requests hh:mm, datetime11 requests hh:mm:ss, datetime12 requests hh:mm AM/PM, datetime13 requests hh:mm:ss AM/PM, uaqdatetime1 requests DD/MM/YYYY using the Umm al-Qura calendar, uaqdatetime2 requests Day, DD Month, YYYY using the Umm al-Qura calendar, uaqdatetime3 requests DD Month, YYYY using the Umm al-Qura calendar, uaqdatetime4 requests DD/MM/YY using the Umm al-Qura calendar, uaqdatetime5 requests YYYY-DD-MM using the Umm al-Qura calendar, uaqdatetime6 requests DD-Month-YY using the Umm al-Qura calendar, and uaqdatetime7 requests DD Month YYYY using the Umm al-Qura calendar.

anchorCenter.description: Whether the text body is anchored at the center of its shape; distinct from verticalAlignment.

forceAntiAlias.description: Whether the direct text-body forceAA rendering hint is enabled; this does not claim host-specific anti-aliasing output.

spaceFirstLastParagraph.description: Whether the direct text-body spcFirstLastPara spacing hint is enabled; this does not infer paragraph metrics.

compatibleLineSpacing.description: Whether the direct text-body compatLnSpc hint is enabled; this does not infer host line metrics.

fromWordArt.description: Whether the direct text-body fromWordArt marker is enabled; this does not claim WordArt transform or effects support.

textWarpPreset.description: Direct a:prstTxWarp preset; only the paired literal textWarpAdjustments profile is modeled.

textWarpAdjustments.description: Ordered direct a:prstTxWarp adjustment guides; each value is a literal fmla=val N and names must be unique.

flatTextZ.description: Signed bounded z coordinate for direct a:flatTx in the 3D scene; this does not model the surrounding 3D scene or effects.

normalAutoFit.description: Optional canonical a:normAutofit percentages; requires autoFit shrink-text and retains at most three decimal places.

hoverAction.description: A bounded mouse-over action for shape-producing elements. It uses the same safe target vocabulary as action and is written as DrawingML a:hlinkHover.

hidden.description: Hide this element while retaining it in the page program. This is independent of page visibility and z-order.

locked.description: Apply OfficeKit's canonical type-specific edit lock. This is an authoring aid, not document protection or access control.

textStyle.description: Direct element text style, distinct from the text-container style.

path.description: Canonical typed line path. Use this form for imported/source-bound edits.

points.description: Kimi authored coordinate pairs. The first and last points are on-curve and middle points are Bezier controls; authored smooth lowering accepts 2 through 128 points, while compact readback is retained only when the bounded native path can be reconstructed safely.

opacity.description: Line-level normal opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.

iconName.description: Canonical name in OfficeKit's pinned offline Font Awesome Free catalog. Build never fetches icons from the network.

adjustments.description: Complete ordered preset-shape adjustment values in DrawingML units. Omit or use [] for native defaults. Percentage-like values use 100000 as 100%; angle values use 60000 units per degree.

svgAsset.description: Source-bound SVG member of a native raster/SVG fallback pair. Authored images use asset and do not manufacture a paired fallback topology.

styleRef.description: Optional reusable image paint style from design.styles.image.

style.description: Inline image paint style; field-level precedence may select it over the named image style.

fit.description: Image fit may be a literal or a design grammar token of kind string; the resolved value must be cover, contain, stretch, tile, or none.

focus.description: Optional focal point used only with cover fit to derive an asymmetric crop.

opacity.description: Image opacity; a token reference must declare kind opacity.

title.description: Use a string for one uniform title or paragraphs/runs for bounded mixed typography. Chart-title hyperlinks, formula references, WordArt, effects, and unknown native title topology remain unsupported or source-owned. titleTextStyle supplies defaults only where a structured run omits the corresponding property.

fontFamily.description: Chart-wide Latin typeface; a string grammar token must resolve to a non-empty string. The bounded native profile writes c:chartSpace/c:txPr and does not infer East Asian or complex-script fallbacks.

titlePlacement.description: Chart-title placement; none omits the title, aboveChart is the native default, and centeredOverlay writes c:title/c:overlay val=1. A string grammar token must resolve to one of these values.

displayBlanksAs.description: How blank cells are plotted; a string grammar token must resolve to zero, gap, or span.

styleIndex.description: Built-in native ChartML style index; a size grammar token must resolve to an integer from 1 through 48. It applies only to bounded native ChartPart charts.

dataTable.description: Bounded native chart data table; the four border/key flags and direct fill/stroke map to c:plotArea/c:dTable.

oneOf.description: Bounded Kimi-compatible axis array; index 0 is primary and index 1 is secondary.
Bounded Kimi-compatible axis array; index 0 is primary and index 1 is secondary.

nullHandling.description: Optional missing-value behavior for line, area, or radar series. All declared values in one chart must agree; connect maps to the native span mode.

levels.description: Optional hierarchy depth hint for treemap and sunburst dataset series.

nullHandling.description: Optional missing-value behavior for line, area, or radar series. All declared values in one chart must agree; connect maps to the native span mode.

categoryFormula.description: Optional source-bound ChartML category reference. It is preserved as a formula string and is not evaluated by PPJ.

xValueFormula.description: Optional source-bound ChartML numeric X reference. It is preserved as a formula string and is not evaluated by PPJ.

valueFormula.description: Optional source-bound ChartML numeric Y reference. It is preserved as a formula string and is not evaluated by PPJ.

bubbleSizeFormula.description: Optional source-bound ChartML bubble-size reference. It is preserved as a formula string and is not evaluated by PPJ.

xAxisIndex.description: Optional bounded combo-axis index emitted by projection; 0 is primary and 1 is secondary.

yAxisIndex.description: Optional bounded combo-axis index emitted by projection; 0 is primary and 1 is secondary.

nullHandling.description: Optional missing-value behavior for line, area, or radar series. All declared values in one chart must agree; connect maps to the native span mode.

chartFormula.description: A bounded ChartML formula reference. PPJ preserves the reference text but does not execute it; external workbook links and unsupported formulas remain source-bound.

legend.description: Chart legend placement; a string grammar token is resolved and checked against the bounded placements.

legendOverlay.description: Whether the chart legend may overlay the plot; a boolean grammar token is resolved and preserved as c:legend/c:overlay.

legendFill.description: Bounded direct legend surface paint; none, solid RGB, or literal gradient is emitted as c:legend/c:spPr.

legendLine.description: Bounded direct legend outline; color, width, and dash are emitted as c:legend/c:spPr/a:ln.

stacking.description: Chart stacking mode; a string grammar token is resolved and checked against the bounded modes.

gapWidth.description: Column gap width; a size grammar token must resolve to a bounded integer.

overlap.description: Column-series overlap percentage; a size grammar token must resolve to an integer from -100 through 100.

startAngle.description: First pie/doughnut slice angle; a size grammar token must resolve to a bounded integer.

holeSize.description: Doughnut hole size; a size grammar token must resolve to a bounded integer.

bubbleScale.description: Bubble scale; a size grammar token must resolve to a bounded integer.

plotAreaLine.description: Bounded direct plot-area outline; color, width, and dash are emitted as c:plotArea/c:spPr/a:ln.

scatterStyle.description: Scatter plot line/marker mode; maps to c:scatterChart/c:scatterStyle. A string grammar token must resolve to one of the bounded values.

radarStyle.description: Radar plot mode; maps to c:radarChart/c:radarStyle. A string grammar token must resolve to standard, marker, or filled.

fontFamilyComplexScript.description: Direct DrawingML a:cs typeface for complex-script chart text.

fill.description: Bounded direct DrawingML chart-text paint; solid, none, or literal gradient fills are preserved.

visible.description: Axis visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

title.description: Axis title; a token reference must declare kind string.

numberFormat.description: Axis number format code; a token reference must declare kind string.

position.description: Axis placement; horizontal axes accept bottom or top and vertical axes accept left or right; a token reference must declare kind string.

tickLabelInterval.description: Category-axis label interval; literals and size grammar tokens must resolve to an integer from 1 through 10000.

min.description: Value-axis minimum; a token reference must declare kind size.

max.description: Value-axis maximum; a token reference must declare kind size.

majorUnit.description: Value-axis major unit; a token reference must declare kind size and resolve above zero.

minorUnit.description: Value-axis minor unit; a token reference must declare kind size and resolve above zero.

majorTickMark.description: Native major tick-mark position; a token reference must declare kind string.

minorTickMark.description: Native minor tick-mark position; a token reference must declare kind string.

reverse.description: Axis direction; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

minorGridLine.description: Native minor gridline visibility or bounded direct stroke; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

tickLabelsVisible.description: Tick-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

tickLabelPosition.description: Native tick-label position; a token reference must declare kind string.

show.description: Radar spoke visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

min.description: Radar value-axis minimum; a token reference must declare kind size.

max.description: Radar value-axis maximum; a token reference must declare kind size.

majorUnit.description: Radar major unit; a token reference must declare kind size and resolve above zero.

numberFormat.description: Radar spoke label number format code; a token reference must declare kind string.

fontFamilyComplexScript.description: Direct DrawingML a:cs typeface for complex-script radar labels.

showValue.description: Value-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showCategory.description: Category-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showSeries.description: Series-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showPercent.description: Percentage-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showBubbleSize.description: Bubble-size label visibility; true requires a bubble chart or bubble series, and a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showLeaderLines.description: Leader-line visibility for native data labels; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

position.description: Native data-label position; a token reference must declare kind string.

fill.description: Bounded direct data-label surface paint; none, solid RGB, or literal gradient is emitted as c:dLbls/c:spPr.

line.description: Bounded direct data-label outline; color, width, and dash are emitted as c:dLbls/c:spPr/a:ln.

numberFormat.description: Data-label number format code; a token reference must declare kind string.

showValue.description: Value-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showCategory.description: Category-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showSeries.description: Series-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showPercent.description: Percentage-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showBubbleSize.description: Bubble-size label visibility; true requires a bubble series, and a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showLeaderLines.description: Leader-line visibility for native series data labels; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

position.description: Native series data-label position; a token reference must declare kind string.

numberFormat.description: Series data-label number format code; a token reference must declare kind string.

text.description: Bounded literal point data-label text; a single c:dLbl/c:tx/c:rich paragraph and run is emitted.

showValue.description: Value-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showCategory.description: Category-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showSeries.description: Series-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showPercent.description: Percentage-label visibility; a token reference must declare kind boolean.

showBubbleSize.description: Bubble-size label visibility; true requires a bubble series, and a token reference must declare kind boolean.

position.description: Native point data-label position; a token reference must declare kind string.

fill.description: Bounded direct point data-label fill; none, solid RGB, or literal gradient is emitted as c:dLbl/c:spPr.

line.description: Bounded direct point data-label outline; RGB color, width, and preset dash are emitted as c:dLbl/c:spPr/a:ln.

numberFormat.description: Point data-label number format code; a token reference must declare kind string.

readingOrder.description: Explicit reading order for direct group children. In the bounded native profile it is also the physical child z-order; it must be a complete permutation of the group's direct element IDs.

playback.description: Bounded authored start trigger. Omission preserves click-start behavior; imported media timing remains source-owned.

mediaPlayback.description: Bounded authored media start trigger. It does not model imported timing graphs or host playback behavior.

textStyle.description: Direct element text style, distinct from the text-container style.

fit.description: SmartArt cached picture paint fit. The bounded native profile accepts stretch or tile; cover/contain remain authored picture-element semantics outside this cache owner.

readingOrder.description: Explicit top-level reading order. It must be a complete permutation of page element IDs; it is never inferred from visual z-order.

anchor.description: Align the finite repeated layout within the instance frame on both axes when the bounded profile leaves slack space.

weights.description: Positive slot weights for authored horizontal or vertical stack repeats; provide exactly one value per item.
